questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Keller und Herr Bruce unterhalten sich über eine Ausstellung.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Keller and Mr. Bruce are carrying on a conversation about an exhibition.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr und Frau Keller waren schon zweimal in dieser Ausstellung.

answers.answer_text: Mr. and Mrs. Keller have been to this exhibition twice already.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie gefiel ihnen ausgesprochen gut.

answers.answer_text: They liked it extremely well.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Bruce war noch nicht dort, da er wochentags zuviel zu tun hat.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Bruce hasn't been there yet since he has too much to do on weekdays.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er wusste nicht, dass die Ausstellung sonntags geöffnet ist.

answers.answer_text: He didn't know that the exhibition is open on Sundays.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr und Frau Jones waren in Garmisch-Partenkirchen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. and Mrs. Jones were in Garmisch-Partenkirchen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es gefiel ihnen dort sehr gut.

answers.answer_text: They liked it there very much.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie hatten Glück mit dem Wetter.

answers.answer_text: They were lucky as far as the weather was concerned.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zuerst regnete es zwar, aber der Rest der Woche war dann sehr schön.

answers.answer_text: It rained at first to be sure, but then the rest of the week was very nice.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie konnten sogar mehrere Bergtouren machen.

answers.answer_text: They were even able to take several hikes in the mountains.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bergmanns verbrachten ihren Urlaub in Pyrmont.

answers.answer_text: The Bergmanns spent their vacation in Pyrmont.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie fuhren zur Kur dorthin.

answers.answer_text: They went there to take the waters.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Auf ihrer Rückreise fuhren sie über Hannover.

answers.answer_text: On their way back they drove through Hanover.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie haben dort die Industriemesse besucht.

answers.answer_text: They visited the industrial exposition there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Meyer war auf einer interessanten Konferenz im Wirtschaftsministerium.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Meyer was at an interesting conference at the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Keller hatte eine wichtige Besprechung im Auswärtigen Amt.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Keller had an important conference at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte leider keine Zeit mehr, noch ins Wirtschaftsministerium zu gehen.

answers.answer_text: He unfortunately didn't have any time left to go to the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In der Zeitung stand neulich ein Artikel über neue Konzernbildungen und Kartellfragen.

answers.answer_text: In the newspaper the other day there was an article about new combines being formed and cartel questions.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Schumann sprach gestern in der Konferenz auch darüber.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Schumann talked about that at the conference yesterday, too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Leider kam es danach zu keiner Diskussion, da die Zeit nicht ausreichte.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately a discussion did not arise afterwards as there wasn't enough time.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es waren auch einige Betriebsleiter da.

answers.answer_text: There were a few plant managers there too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ein Gewerkschaftssekretär gab langatmige Erklärungen ab.

answers.answer_text: A union official gave out with long-winded explanations.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Martin rief Frau Köhler an.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Martin called up Mrs. Köhler.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er bedankte sich für einen netten Abend bei Köhlers.

answers.answer_text: He expressed his thanks for a pleasant evening at the Köhlers' house.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Da Frau Martin noch im Urlaub war, konnte sie nicht zu Köhlers gehen.

answers.answer_text: Since Mrs. Martin was still away on her vacation she wasn't able to go to the Köhlers'.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In acht Tagen kommt sie aber zurück.

answers.answer_text: She is coming back in a week however.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Köhlers sollen Martins auch bald besuchen.

answers.answer_text: The Köhlers are to visit the Martins soon too.
